 FAA nationwide ground stop lifted: Latest sports news as teams’ travel plans affected by flight delays, cancellations
 A nationwide ground stop left teams scrambling to make plans for their games. Live Blog Chat The Athletic Staff November 14, 2026 at 1:56 AM EST The FAA issued “a nationwide ground stop for all U.S. airports” on Friday.   David Zalubowski / AP Photo 25 New Updates Grace Raynor · Staff Writer, Recruiting Teams scramble after FAA ground stop
 The Federal Aviation Administration stopped air traffic across the United States on Friday, immediately creating uncertainty for dozens of teams traveling to games across various sports. 
 The weekend is expected to be a busy slate of college football and basketball games, along with NBA games, NHL games and a full NFL schedule on Sunday. The full extent of how the stoppage might affect those plans is not fully clear.
 U.S. Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy said in a social media post that the FAA had issued “a nationwide ground stop for all U.S. airports” and that FAA technicians are investigating a “communication issue impacting all Air Route Traffic Control Centers.”
 Duffy said at a news conference from the White House about four hours later that the halt had been lifted and some flights were resuming.
 “If you miss a baseball game, you miss a wedding, I care about you getting there without any harm,” Duffy said.
 Many top teams have already arrived at their respective destinations. But some are considering alternate travel methods after being unable to fly as scheduled.

 November 13, 2026 at 7:22 PM EST Henry Bushnell · Senior Writer, U.S. Soccer USMNT game not impacted
 Saturday’s U.S. men’s national soccer team game against Haiti in Miami won’t be affected, a spokesperson for Concacaf, the regional governing body in charge of the match, told The Athletic .
 Both teams and match officials are already in Miami. The U.S. team’s flight from Atlanta touched down just before the FAA issued the nationwide ground stop. 
 “Everyone is already on-site, and the match will proceed as scheduled,” the spokesperson said.
 November 13, 2026 at 7:21 PM EST Scott Dochterman · Staff Writer, Big Ten Big Ten hasn't made decision about games impacted by travel
 I asked a Big Ten official about any possible plans to postpone or cancel games. The response: not at this point. Still working through tomorrow.
 November 13, 2026 at 7:19 PM EST Chris Vannini · Senior Writer, CFB Kirk Herbstreit supposed to call LSU-Texas
 Adding to the point Andrew Marchand made , Kirk Herbstreit is scheduled to call the LSU-Texas game at night, meaning he would need a flight from Boise to Louisiana during the day, or Chris Fowler will need someone else next to him.
 Fowler and Holly Rowe are at the game location. It is not yet known who would call the game with them if Herbstreit can't fly.
 November 13, 2026 at 7:16 PM EST Fred Katz · Senior Writer, Knicks The Knicks are just like us ... waiting
 I spoke with a number of Knicks people before tipoff about the team’s flight situation. The latest update: They are waiting to find out the next steps, just like anyone else. The team is not sure yet if it will be able to leave Indianapolis after the game tonight, as previously planned, or if it will have to stay the night here.
 November 13, 2026 at 7:15 PM EST Andrew Marchand · Senior Writer, National Broadcasters' travel could be impacted
 The travel for NFL and college football announcers could be disrupted. While ESPN College GameDay's crew has made it to Boise, Idaho, ESPN was checking to see if on-air game personnel would be in position around the country. Presumably, most arrived earlier. Potentially, a bigger issue are NFL broadcasters. While most fly on Friday, some do not, which could cause issues if their flights do not go out tomorrow.

 November 13, 2026 at 7:04 PM EST Chris Vannini · Senior Writer, CFB What is the impact if college football games are canceled?
 There are so many potential trickle-down impacts to this in college football if games are canceled.
 Will conference races come down to winning percentage in the standings, like in 2020? How will the College Football Playoff selection committee compare more teams that didn’t play the same number of games?
 Home football game revenue is enormously vital to budgets, though game contracts more often have insurance since the pandemic.
 November 13, 2026 at 6:56 PM EST Eric Nehm · Senior Writer, Heat Cleveland Cavaliers looking for hotel rooms: 'If not, we'll sleep on the bus'
   Colin Hubbard / Getty Images MIAMI — Cleveland Cavaliers head coach Kenny Atkinson has an NBA Cup game to focus on tonight in Miami against the Heat, but the Cavaliers also have a flight scheduled to get back home to play the Dallas Mavericks tomorrow night. As he stepped in front of a microphone before tonight’s game, he admitted he has no idea if his team will be able to make their way home after tonight’s game.
 “I haven’t heard,” Atkinson said when asked if he is under the impression the Cavaliers will be able to leave Miami tonight. “I think we’re scrambling to find hotel rooms in case, which I can’t imagine, oh man. If not, we’ll sleep on the bus.”
 While that is a lot of unknown about tomorrow night’s game heading into tonight’s game, Atkinson told reporters he believes players are well-prepared to handle something like this.
 “These guys are so adaptable and flexible,” Atkinson said. “There’s so much stuff that’s going on in the world. I feel like they deal with information really well and all the twists and turns of the season. It happens sometimes in the NBA.
 “Flights are late, get stuck on the runway, just like it does in the normal commercial world of flight, so it’s just part of it. We’ve all been part of it. You just adapt. We obviously have a game tomorrow night, so that’s in the back of my mind. What does that look like if we have to stay and all that?”
 November 13, 2026 at 6:54 PM EST Matt Barrows · Senior Writer, 49ers San Francisco 49ers plan to travel to Dallas on Saturday
 The San Francisco 49ers had long planned to leave Saturday at 1 p.m. PT for their game against the Dallas Cowboys because they have an extended road trip in which they will head to Colorado Springs, Colo., after Sunday’s game to practice in elevation before their Nov. 21 game in Mexico City. This weekend’s game in Dallas doesn’t start until 4:25 p.m. ET.
 November 13, 2026 at 6:52 PM EST Eric Stephens · Staff Writer, Ducks & Kings Sharks still in San Jose
 The Sharks are still in San Jose and don’t have any updates on their departure time. They play against the Mammoth in Utah on Saturday. 
 November 13, 2026 at 6:47 PM EST Jonathan Jones · Senior Writer, NFL Will this hurt NFL games on Sunday?
   Elsa / Getty Images NFL teams typically travel on Saturdays for Sunday games. Teams going from one coast to the other can leave on Friday to better acclimate to the time zone change, but this Sunday’s slate does not have any such game between teams. The Los Angeles Chargers play in Baltimore against the Ravens on “Monday Night Football,” but the Chargers have planned to travel east Sunday morning, reports The Athletic ’s Noah Furtado.
 Sources at five teams contacted Friday evening each said their travel plans are unchanged at that time.
 The NFL did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
 Sunday night’s game between the Cincinnati Bengals and Pittsburgh Steelers represents the shortest distance between opponents this weekend. Cincinnati is about 290 miles away from Pittsburgh, which hosts the AFC North battle Sunday night.

 November 13, 2026 at 6:39 PM EST Matt Baker · Staff Writer, College Notre Dame fans feeling the pain
 I just chatted with a handful of Notre Dame fans who have tickets to the Boston College game. Their flight from Tampa to Chicago’s Midway Airport is grounded, making their once-a-year Irish game very unlikely. They're not out lodging costs because they were set to stay with family. 
 “Sucks, but life goes on,” Irish fan Mike Sweet said.
 November 13, 2026 at 6:35 PM EST Grace Raynor · Staff Writer, Recruiting ACC football games should go on as planned
 Every ACC school has made it to its destination, the league confirmed.
 November 13, 2026 at 6:34 PM EST Bruce Feldman · Senior Writer, CFB Purdue on tarmac when ground stop started
 The Purdue team was on the tarmac ready to take off, and then its plane just stopped and stayed there for about an hour. Then, the Boilermakers audibled to a bus ride to Iowa. They’re now on a 330-mile ride to Iowa City. They expect to arrive at their hotel right at about the time of their planned bed-check time Friday night.
 “Fortunately,” a team source told The Athletic from their bus ride, “we’ll have most of the day tomorrow to get ready. The guys have been handling all this really well.”
 Kickoff at Iowa is set for 7:30 p.m. ET Saturday.
 November 13, 2026 at 6:32 PM EST The Athletic College Football Staff College football updates on Texas, Ole Miss
 Texas returned to the team facility. 
 Ole Miss was sent home and told to keep their phone on them for updates. The team hadn’t left the facility yet.
 The Texas football team has returned to campus pic.twitter.com/7Y2KAirhOZ 
— Travis Recek (@TravisRecek) November 13, 2026 
 November 13, 2026 at 6:28 PM EST Scott Dochterman · Staff Writer, Big Ten USC football arrives in Indiana
 USC's plane has landed so that game is on.

 November 13, 2026 at 6:27 PM EST Grace Raynor · Staff Writer, Recruiting What will ESPN do?
 It’ll be interesting to see how ESPN, the biggest network for college football, handles all of this. Seems like it’s inevitable the network will have to do some major rearranging if teams can’t make it to destinations and the whole slate gets thrown off.
 November 13, 2026 at 6:26 PM EST David Ubben · Staff Writer, College Football Will teams have to travel and play the same day?
 I’m curious about the prospect of teams flying to games on the same day they’re supposed to be be played. A lot of these games have high stakes and a lot of potential money involved. And coaches are creatures of habit who have their own livelihoods at stake. I would expect schools to buck hard at any suggestion they could travel early tomorrow morning and kick off at night.
 Utah and Tennessee say no discussions about contingency plans yet. They’re just waiting for word from the FAA and in the process of eating dinner.
 November 13, 2026 at 6:24 PM EST Joe Vardon · Senior Writer, NBA NBA referee availability could be impacted
 The NBA said it would not have any further comment on potential game cancellations for Saturday until more information about the ground stop was available.
 One development to keep track of is referee availability. Unlike the teams, which fly chartered planes, referees fly commercial. If the officials assigned to games on Saturday are caught like the rest of us, they aren’t necessarily getting to their destinations even if the hold on flights is lifted Friday evening.
 The NBA was not immediately certain of how many referees were impacted by the ground stop. Each game typically has three officials.
 November 13, 2026 at 6:15 PM EST Chris Vannini · Senior Writer, CFB Taking the bus: Three college football teams will drive
 At least three college football teams have decided to take a bus to their games:
 Auburn: Around 4 hours to Mississippi State
 Purdue: Around 5 hours to Iowa
 North Texas: Around 5 hours to UTSA
